paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend. Being born into the right family, or holding the right card, doesn't set anybody free. The crowd said, "We are Abraham's descendants," and Jesus said that "everyone who sins is a slave to sin" (John 8:33, 34). That's a gym card in the wallet again, because carrying the name isn't the same as doing the work.

So how does anybody get free? Jesus says, "So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed" (John 8:36). It starts when we "continue in My word" (John 8:31). Free doesn't come from our family tree or from trying harder. It comes from the Son, and He is the One who never needs a second try.

And now look at who this Son is, because that's the heart of it. "Before Abraham was born, I am!" (John 8:58). He wasn't just a good teacher passing through the temple. He is the One the whole Bible has been pointing to, and He still says "if anyone keeps My word, he will never see death" (John 8:51). So keep baking in the Word, baker, because that's where you meet the One who sets you free. The story isn't over, and neither is the teaching.
